_source: Synthetic plans as a careful model would write them in its own words (review of grounding, 2026-09-25): synonyms instead of the brief's words («работники экономят», «переписка», «расширение»), a change with its unit written once («с 47 до 29 минут»), a change the brief gives as было/стало or до/после внедрения, derived values (a difference, a percent change from the earlier value, a ratio, points of a score), a rounding («27%» for 27,4%), a date in another format («15 октября 2026 года» for 15.10.2026). Grounding must keep every slide and figure of them. «live» is the create screen's four-line example brief (live_cloudru_brief.json).
